titulo: I just got here, said after ten minutes
caption:
I just got here, said after ten minutes

My friend is always ten minutes early and always says she just got here. Then I checked the clock.

A small white lie like I just got here spares the other person any feeling that they kept you waiting.

For whoever arrives early and says they just got here.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right and a small digital clock that reads 4:50, then 4:55, then 5:00. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes waits on the left. At 5:00 the door opens and a royal blue figure walks in with happy eyes and a bubble that says hi! on time! The black one's eyes go wide, then happy, and a bubble says I just got here. Both pulse. The text stays: me ten minutes early saying I just got here. The last card: Choose friction.
